correctness.rationale: The commutator on every arrow has the proved row δ_i v_i−u_i(c_i−c_{i+1}); nonzero δ_i give independent arrow-input pivots. The remaining incidence rows are independent on a proper subset of a cycle; only the full-support constant-diagonal case creates one relation. Counting via a transfer-matrix trace gives the precise polynomial and q(q−1)^n top-degree correction. The centralizer-rank identity derives the probability. The packaged finite-field Gaussian-elimination program constructs multiplication independently and exhaustively agrees in nine small cases, including GF(4). n=2, characteristic 2, k=0/n and normalization at z=1 checked. Finite checks do not prove the general assertion.

value.rationale: The full n,q rank spectrum is a natural invariant giving every centralizer dimension and exact commuting probability of a standard selfinjective radical-square-zero Nakayama algebra. The single cycle produces a genuinely structural top-rank dependence absent in proper forests and in the closest acyclic two-vertex quiver theorem. This is a complete, characteristic-uniform classification with direct ring-theoretic meaning, not a chosen arbitrary invariant or finite table.
